text: 2012. World map of night lights on a dark background. Bright clusters of city lights show across the eastern and western United States, western Europe, India, eastern China, Japan and Korea. The Nile appears as a thin glowing line through Egypt. Most of Africa, the Amazon and the interior of Australia are dark. Greenland and Antarctica appear as grey ice.

2023. The same world view as 2012. At this scale it looks very similar: the same regions are bright, and the same areas are dark. Small differences are easier to see in the change map and in the regional views.

Change map, 2012 to 2023. The same world view in dim colours. Purple marks places that look brighter in 2023 than in 2012, and orange marks places that look dimmer. Purple marks are spread widely, including the eastern United States, India, eastern China and Southeast Asia. Orange marks stand out in the United Kingdom and France.
